notes.title: Update Ver1.0.4
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented.

・Fixed a bug where dummy images weren't masked when “Change Appearance”

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/f48b98cccb19cd29aff9321a254170275c541104.png"]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.3
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented.

・Added the ability to change character colors after creation

・Added the ability to change equipment at the Adventurers' Guild

・Added the ability to view the Item Index anywhere

・Added the ability to check monster stats during battle

・Changed so characters blown away by enemy monsters' “gust of wind” return to the party immediately after battle

・Shortened the effect when using “Slash” on the field

・Changed the design of the icon indicating your current location on the map

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/f48b98cccb19cd29aff9321a254170275c541104.png"]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.2
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented.

Fixed an issue where “Crude medicine” could not be used on the field under certain conditions

Adjusted the power of the “Fighter” skill ‘Charge’

Fixed so that the “Unlock Door” skill automatically activates when touching a key door

Fixed the map UI

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565070/ac5f978ea9a478890906cd0bcb9bf4161e39f414.png"]

notes.title: Update Ver1.0.1
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented.

Fixed an issue where doors not within the player's field of view were mapped

Fixed some UI glitches during combat

Fixed an issue where BGM would not play after using “Onsoku”

Fixed an issue where “Elixir” and “Crude medicine” could not be used in the field

Fixed an issue where Undead afflicted with status ailments were not affected by ‘Dispel’ and “Disenchant”

Fixed an issue where the “Unlock Door” skill could still be used to force open doors even if the user was incapacitated.

Fixed an issue with message display when attempting to remove cursed equipment.

Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing keys during a saved game load could corrupt the data.

Fixed an issue where the order of held items would sometimes become scrambled.

Fixed an issue where spell effects were not displayed when using books.

Fixed an issue where the current quantity of items was not displayed when buying or selling items.

Adjusted item drop rates.

Adjusted parameters and spawn rates for “Dark Hero”.

Changed the drop item for “Dancing Coin”.

Fixed character creation to highlight insufficient stats in red.

Fixed ‘Onsoku’ to be usable only once per battle.

Adjusted the extinguishing speed of “Torch”.

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.5.1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with Chinese and Korean input on SteamDeck

Fixed an issue where multiple items could not be purchased in the store

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.5.0
notes.content:
Support for French, German, and Korean

Addition of tutorial messages

Addition and modification of some graphics and effects

Addition of settings items

Key response fixes

Price adjustments for some items

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.4.4
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where party members would disappear under certain conditions when the third party member joined.
 Fixed an issue where the title screen would display color bars when playing on Steam Deck.
 Fixed an issue where items could be selected in excess of the available stock when purchasing items in the shop.
 Assigned the “Back” function to the Escape key.
 Adjusted game speed.
 Added auto-save functionality.
 Added a load screen.

notes.title: Demo version update Ver. 0.4.3
notes.content:
Fixed UI corruption in the Adventurer's Guild.
Fixed a bug that freezes when using an item with 1 item in possession.
